timestamp_rule: parse year-month-day-hour as Asia/Shanghai civil time, then subtract eight hours to record UTC; ordering is invariant
value_rule: parse PM2.5 as IEEE-754 decimal; empty or NA becomes missing; retain raw decimal text in the open values table
missing_policy: preserve missing values; never impute or interpolate
duplicate_policy: any duplicate station/timestamp makes that parent ineligible and is preserved in the failure ledger
range_policy: negative finite PM2.5 is invalid; no upper clipping
sorting_policy: sort by timestamp only after duplicate and source-order audits; record whether source order differed
